name: input
title: Input
description: A compound input component with wrapper, icons, affixes, and inline affixes. Uses namespace exports: Input.Root, Input.Wrapper, Input.Input, Input.Icon, Input.Affix, Input.InlineAffix.

migration.guide: API changed: now uses compound component pattern with namespace exports. Import as `import * as Input from ...`. Use `<Input.Root>` with `<Input.Wrapper>` and `<Input.Input>` children. Old flat `<Input>` component removed. Uses tv (tailwind-variants) instead of manual class config. Uses recursiveCloneChildren for prop propagation.

docs.lead: A compound input component with wrapper, icons, affixes, and size/error variants.
docs.usage:
import * as Input from "@/components/ui/input"

<Input.Root>
  <Input.Wrapper>
    <Input.Icon as={RiSearchLine} />
    <Input.Input placeholder="Search…" />
  </Input.Wrapper>
</Input.Root>

examples.title: Label and Hint
examples.description: Input composed with Label and Hint components.
examples.code:
<FormField.Root
  label="Email Address"
  htmlFor="email"
  hint="This is a hint text to help user."
>
  <Input.Root>
    <Input.Wrapper>
      <Input.Icon as={RiMailLine} />
      <Input.Input
        id="email"
        type="email"
        placeholder="hello@example.com"
      />
    </Input.Wrapper>
  </Input.Root>
</FormField.Root>

examples.title: With Inline Select
examples.description: Input with an inline select for permissions inside the wrapper.
examples.code:
<Input.Root>
  <Input.Wrapper>
    <Input.Icon as={RiUser6Line} />
    <Input.Input placeholder="Placeholder text…" />
    <Select.Root variant="inline" defaultValue="view">
      <Select.Trigger>
        <Select.TriggerIcon as={RiGlobalLine} />
        <Select.Value />
      </Select.Trigger>
      <Select.Content>
        <Select.Item value="view">can view</Select.Item>
        <Select.Item value="edit">can edit</Select.Item>
      </Select.Content>
    </Select.Root>
  </Input.Wrapper>
</Input.Root>

examples.title: Composed
examples.description: Simplified usage via the Composed wrapper with leadingIcon, trailingIcon, and node slots.
examples.code:
import * as Input from "@/components/ui/input"

<Input.Composed
  leadingIcon={RiLock2Line}
  type="password"
  placeholder="••••••••••"
  inlineTrailingNode={<button>Toggle</button>}
/>
